# Cabinpanda

CabinPanda is a data collection platform that enables users to create and manage online forms, facilitating efficient data gathering and analysis.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cabinpanda/.

## Actions

- **Create Form**: Create a new form with specified fields and settings.
- **Delete Form**: Delete a specific form by its id.
- **Delete Integration**: Delete a specific integration by its id.
- **Get Form Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific form by its id.
- **Get Integration Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific integration by its id.
- **Get Profile** (read-only): Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information.
- **List form submissions** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all submissions for a specific form.
- **List Forms** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all forms associated with the account.
- **List Integrations** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all integrations for the account.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all users associated with the account.
